lower.text:
vA (You may only have one “Goku’s Spirit
Bomb” attached.)

POWER: Attach to your MP. Gain 5 stages. While
attached, whenever a personality you control would
gain stages during the Planning Step, you may place

that many counters on this card instead. While attached,
you may banish this card as an action to perform an
energy attack dealing X life cards. X =the number
of counters on this card.
